labels = ["box", "box", "box"]

    detected_objects = Object_Detector_Tool.execute(image=image_path, labels=labels, threshold=threshold, model_size=model_size, save_object=True, saved_image_path="detected_objects")

    # Extract the object labels
    labels_dict = {}
    object_num_dict = {}

    for detection_entry in detected_objects[1]:
        label = detection_entry["labels"][0]
        num_objects = detection_entry["object_num"]
        labels_dict[label] = detection_entry["box"]
        object_num_dict[label] = num_objects

    final_result.append({"detected_objects": {"baseball": labels_dict, "basket": labels_dict}, "object_num": object_num_dict})
else:
    final_result.append({"no_boxes": []})

print(final_result)

    for obj_labels, box in final_result[0]["detected_objects"].items():
